scores.notes: Watson is the moustached man in the bowler with the doctor's bag on the left and the moustached man lying on the bed on the right; brown moustache, age and build match, though his arm covers his eyes on the right.
Both show a calm pale-dawn lake shore with a flat-roofed stone village at the water's edge, hazy hills behind and a small coal fire on the beach; right adds palms but the layout is compatible.
Watson at the door on the left and seated by the bed on the right: same short dark-brown side-parted hair, brown moustache, middle age and solid build.
Daniel is the standing man in the blue fringed mantle with a satchel in both: short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, brown skin and older age match.
Alice in both is a fair-skinned girl with long light-brown hair held by a dark headband, same young face; hair is wavier and she looks a little taller on the left but no identity cue conflicts.
Both show a sandy seabed corridor between curling green wave-walls running back to pale desert dunes on the far shore under a grey sky; left sky is stormier but the place is compatible.
Holmes (throwing the paper ball on the left, holding the lens on the right) has the same slicked-back black hair, gaunt clean-shaven face, hooked nose and lean build.

Holmes (reaching for the paper ball on the left, in the armchair on the right) is a lean clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair and a sharp nose in both; he looks somewhat younger and less gaunt on the left but no cue clearly conflicts.
Moses (arm stretched at the sea on the left, seated on the stone on the right) has the same white shoulder-length hair, full white beard, old age and tan skin.
Both show the same wooden boat with a mast lantern on a dark night sea, a hilly shore with a small village on the left horizon and a moon breaking through storm cloud.
Holmes (seated right in the carriage; pulling Watson in at the door) has the same slicked-back black hair, gaunt clean-shaven face, hooked nose and thin build.
Holmes (pointing at the red-haired client on the left, tossing the paper ball on the right) has the same slicked-back black hair with widow's peak, gaunt clean-shaven face and thin build.

Peter is the man diving from the boat on the left and the man gripping the beggar's hand on the right; both have short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tan skin and a sturdy build, though the diver's face is small and angled down and the right shows a little more grey.

Peter in the left foreground (hand on chest) has grey curly hair and a grey beard and looks elderly, while the man raising the beggar on the right has dark brown-black curly hair and a mostly dark beard and looks middle-aged.

Both show an open wooden fishing boat on a grey-green lake ringed by steep dark headlands under heavy storm cloud; the left is mid-storm and the right calming as the passages ask, and the torn sail on the right is the only small mismatch.
Alice (holding the flamingo on the left, standing tall in court on the right) has the same long light-brown hair with a dark headband, fair skin and young girl's face.

Moses (striking the rock on the left, leading with the crook staff on the right) is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard and tan skin in both; hair is a little longer on the left but nothing conflicts.

Peter (stepping from the boat on the left, the dripping man in the ragged brown mantle by the fire on the right) has the same short dark curly hair, short dark greying beard, weathered tan face and stocky build.
Moses (arm stretched over the sea on the left, pointing with staff at the head of the column on the right) has white hair, a full white beard, old age and the same tan skin in both.
Watson (seated on the bed on the left, in the bowler on the right) has the same brown hair, thick brown moustache, ruddy middle-aged face and sturdy build.

Both show a calm pale lake ringed by the same tawny rounded hills with a small fire on a pebbly shore and a wooden fishing boat just offshore; the right view adds a village and palms from a different angle.
Holmes on the left (studying the hat with a lens) has a full head of thick dark wavy hair, while the man at the door on the right is bald on top with only side hair and a much gaunter, older face.

Moses (foreground with staff on the left, striking the rock on the right) is an elderly tan-skinned man with white hair and white beard in both; hair and beard are somewhat longer on the right but age, colouring and build agree.
Holmes (seated with pipe and photograph on the left, pointing at the client on the right) has the same slicked-back black hair, gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and thin frame.
Holmes (striking with the cane on the left, holding the lens and hat on the right) has the same slicked-back dark hair with widow's peak, hollow-cheeked clean-shaven face and lean build.

Left is a narrow lake at pale twilight with village-dotted hillsides close on both sides; right is open water in deep moonlit night with lightning, other boats and only distant dark headlands, so the time of day and shoreline do not match beyond the storm/calm change.
Jesus (standing in the bow on the left, walking on the water on the right) has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, slim build and tan skin.
Alice (holding the flamingo on the left, drinking from the bottle on the right) has the same long light-brown hair with a headband, fair skin and young girl's face and build.
David (crouching at the brook on the left, kneeling to be anointed on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, ruddy fair skin and slim build.

Peter is clearly the dark-curly-haired bearded man diving on the left, but on the right ten near-identical dark-haired bearded men stand round the fire at a distance and nothing reliably singles out which one is Peter.
Both show pale flat-roofed stone houses behind a low dry-stone wall on a dusty track among terraced olive-and-cypress hills under a clear daytime sky; the right is simply closer to the house.

Both show a grassy lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with oversized mushrooms along the edge and warm autumn-toned trees behind in soft daylight; left uses card-soldier arches and a ridged lawn where the right has wire hoops, a minor difference.
Moses (arm raised at the sea on the left, foreground with staff on the right) is an elderly man with white swept-back hair, full white beard and tan weathered face in both.
Holmes (reaching with the cane on the left, tossing the paper ball on the right) has the same slicked-back black hair, gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and thin build.
Holmes (in the armchair with a pipe on the left, throwing the paper ball on the right) has the same slicked-back black hair, hollow clean-shaven face, hooked nose and lean frame.

Watson (in the bowler with the bag on the street, sitting up in bed shading his eyes on the right) has the same brown hair, thick brown moustache, middle age and stocky build, though he is small in both.

Alice (standing before the bench on the left, facing the Caterpillar on the right) has the same long light-brown hair, fair skin, small child's build and age; she is small and partly turned away on the left so the face is only partly comparable.
Moses (foreground with staff on the left, the staff-bearer at the right of the column on the right) has white hair, a full white beard and elderly build in both, though he is small on the right.
David (stooping for stones on the left, kneeling under the horn of oil on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Left looks from the beach at the sea starting to split under a dark stormy night sky; right is inside the corridor between the same blue-green wave-walls on wet sand under the same dark storm sky, a compatible closer view.
David (kneeling under the oil on the left, dodging the spear on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, light tan skin and slim build in a brown tunic.

David (the sling-holder standing behind fallen Goliath on the left, dodging the spear on the right) is a clean-shaven slim youth with short dark hair and the same skin tone in both, though small on the left.
Daniel (standing among the lions on the left, addressing the king on the right) has the same cropped grey hair, short grey beard, brown skin and older lean build.
Peter (stepping off the bow on the left, the net-draped man clasping the beggar's hand on the right) has short dark curly hair, a short greying dark beard, tan skin and a sturdy build in both.

Holmes on the left is a gaunt, hollow-cheeked older man with slicked-back receding hair, while the man with the lens on the right has thick wavy dark hair falling forward and a fuller, clearly younger face.
Both show the same round ashlar-lined open pit set in sandy ground with a barred grate under a wooden hatch on its rim and palms behind, in grey early light.

Both show a ridged, furrowed green lawn enclosed by a garden wall with tall trees and cypresses under a cloudy sky, with hedgehogs and card soldiers about; wall is grey stone on the left and redder brick on the right, a small difference.
Jesus (gesturing at the tomb on the left, standing in the stern on the right) has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, tan skin and slim build.
Both show the same wooden boat swamped by white-capped grey waves under a black storm sky with dark cliffs along the right horizon; the torn sail is visible only on the left.

Jesus on the water on the left has long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard and a lean build; the central crucified figure on the right shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and lean build, though he is small and his face cannot be read in detail.
David (picking stones at the brook on the left, ducking the spear with his lyre on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and wiry build.
David (crouching at the brook on the left, the slinger behind fallen Goliath on the right) is a clean-shaven slim youth with short black curly hair and tan skin in both, though small on the right.

Jesus at the tomb on the left has long dark-brown hair, a short dark beard and slim build; the central crucified figure on the right shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and lean build, though he is small and the face cannot be read in detail.
Moses (pointing at the pig with his crook on the left, seated on the stone with arms held up on the right) has the same white shoulder-length hair, full white beard, old age and tan skin.

Holmes at the door on the left is bald on top with only dark side hair, while the pipe-smoker on the right has a full head of dark swept-back hair; both are thin and clean-shaven but the hairline clearly conflicts.

Holmes (studying the hat with a lens on the left, reaching for the paper ball on the right) is a lean clean-shaven man with dark hair and a similar youngish face in both; the hair is wavier on the left but no cue clearly conflicts.

Watson (arms folded by the fire on the left, in bowler and brown suit with the bag on the right) has a thick brown moustache, ruddy face and sturdy build in both, though he is small on the right and the hat hides his hair.

Holmes on the left (holding the paper ball) has thick jet-black hair with a fringe and looks around forty, while the man with the cane on the right has thin grey-brown receding hair and a markedly older, more hollow face; both are lean and clean-shaven.

Both show the same open wooden fishing boat with mast, rope coils and stern cushion on a grey-green sea under heavy storm cloud; the right is a close-up in the height of the storm and shows no shoreline, so nothing conflicts beyond the storm/calm change.
